          Plan your travel itinerary and flight to The Red Sea 

          Planning your trip to this vibrant city is a breeze with Saudia Airlines. You'll find it easy to book your flight to The Red Sea (RSI), with a variety of flight times to fit your schedule. Our world-class service will make your journey comfortable and memorable.

          Book your flight to The Red Sea today!

          Flight arrivals at Red Sea International Airport (RSI)

          When you land at Red Sea International Airport (RSI) in The Red Sea, you’ll be greeted by a welcoming and well-organized terminal that ensures a smooth arrival experience. Red Sea International Airport offers a wide range of passenger services to make your arrival in The Red Sea pleasant and convenient. Whether you’re continuing your travels or exploring The Red Sea for the first time, Red Sea International Airport provides everything you need to start your visit comfortably.

           

          Unveil the Red Sea Islands: Dive into a Regenerative Oasis

          Escape to a hidden archipelago where luxury meets the world's fourth-largest barrier reef. Explore over 90 untouched islands, from the coral-inspired shores of Shura to the overwater sanctuaries of Ummahat. Whether you are diving through vibrant marine ecosystems, stargazing over sweeping dunes, or finding balance in a desert wellness spa, this solar-powered haven redefines the art of travel. Your journey into the heart of the Red Sea starts here.


          1. Dive Into Pristine Waters

          Explore vibrant coral reefs and diverse marine life in one of the world's most spectacular underwater ecosystems. Submerge into crystal-clear clarity where visibility reveals thriving aquatic cities teeming with color.


          2. Relax On Untouched Beaches

          Unwind on serene, sun-drenched shores surrounded by crystal-clear waters away from the crowds. Feel the soft sand underfoot as you enjoy complete privacy on these isolated coastal gems.


          3. Sail The Red Sea

          Board a scenic boat excursion or private cruise to island-hop across the stunning archipelago. Discover the open waves and find hidden lagoons perfect for a morning of quiet exploration.


          4. Spot Diverse Marine Wildlife

          Watch for dolphins, sea turtles, and migrating birds in their protected natural habitats. Connect deeply with nature as you observe these magnificent creatures thriving in undisturbed freedom.


          5. Experience Thrilling Water Sports

          Try windsurfing, kayaking, or stand-up paddleboarding along the breathtaking coastline. Feel the energy of the sea as you glide across the pristine surface and embrace outdoor adventure.
